config.confidence: Self-reported low/medium/high certainty, not a calibrated probability.
config.masking: Model labels and source paths masked in packets; assessors know the project models and earlier QA exists. This is not an independent blinded human study.
config.generation_rule: Judge each mandatory criterion as met/absent/uncertain with visible evidence. AI usable concept 1 means shortlist for further design work without major brief/structural correction; 0 requires an observed major failure; null means unresolved. This is not commercial approval.
config.reconstruction_rule: Judge visible input fidelity, shape coherence, texture coherence and cross-view consistency. Unseen-surface correctness is always uncertain without reference geometry. AI usable concept is null for reconstruction.
config.scope: Existing 144 generation outputs and 40 reconstructed objects; four preview views belong to one object, not four independent samples.
config.aggregation: Generation image->prompt->model, retaining three seeds per prompt. Reconstruction view evidence->one object assessment->model. Paired uncertainty resamples whole matched prompts/objects; intervals do not capture AI judge bias.
prohibitions: Never enter these assessments into human ratings or benchmark raw records.
Never infer invisible material properties, exact geometry accuracy, physical dimensions, hidden-surface correctness, commercial clearance or customer feedback.
No model parameter tuning or selective removal after assessment.
No external judge endpoint, GPU model inference or automatic filling of observations.
